title: Understanding human brain function in real-world environments
content:
by Feng Zhou, Benjamin Becker

Functional MRI is invaluable in understanding brain function, but findings are often of limited real-world relevance. Neuroimaging in more naturalistic environments could reveal crucial insights into how the brain processes cognition, emotional experiences, and social interactions in daily life. Functional MRI has been invaluable in understanding brain function, but findings often remain of limited real-world relevance. This Perspective discusses how neuroimaging in more naturalistic environments may reveal crucial insights into human cognition and social interactions in everyday life.
author: Feng Zhou
